preconditions.description: The length of the input word s must be between 1 and 100 characters.
The input word s must consist only of uppercase and lowercase Latin letters.

postconditions.expression: stdout == s.lower() if s.count(c for c in s if c.isupper()) <= s.count(c for c in s if c.islower()) else s.upper()
postconditions.description: The output must be the input word converted to lowercase if it has more or equal lowercase letters, otherwise converted to uppercase.
